raw_text:
PLAN "Postpartum Return — 12 Week Progressive Rebuild"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Return to full activity safely"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Immediate Recovery" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Gentle walk + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 2x10..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Gentle mobility + pelvic floor focus":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Light conditioning and breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x60..90 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk + hip activation":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          step_up 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core-safe stability":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x10..20 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Mobility + gentle cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 3x10..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          hip_circles 3x30..45 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Progressed glute and posterior chain":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          good_morning 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Balance and single-leg work":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Breathing and low-impact cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x90..120 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Consolidation session":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Mobility and light conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x120..150 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          hip_circles 3x30..45 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Low-load posterior chain":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          good_morning 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 — Foundation Strength" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Bodyweight strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Core-safe stability and rows":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          superman 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          prone_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Bodyweight strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Increase volume":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Core progression and posterior chain":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30..40 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          good_morning 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Mobility + conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x180..240 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Strength consolidation":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          push_up 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Unloaded pulling and core":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          superman 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lunge and single-leg strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "End of foundation test":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Core and posterior":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          good_morning 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Conditioning and mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x240..300 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_circles 3x45..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 — Gradual Return to Load" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Intro to loaded movement (bodyweight progressions)":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Posterior chain and pulling":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning and stability":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x300..360 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progress load capacity":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Strength and core safe progress":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Mobility and longer walk":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x360..420 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_circles 3x45..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Load consolidation":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Balanced strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x60..75 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Conditioning and mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x420..480 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_circles 3x45..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Return readiness session":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full-body balanced":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x60..90 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Active recovery and test walk":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 2x20..30 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
